source.provenance: locally authored ezdxf seed converted by ODA File Converter to AC1012; the source and field-span controls are identified by the adjacent legacy XRECORD receipt

candidate.result: refused during output preparation at the typed DWG ModelDocViewStyle exact-source-version guard
candidate.reason: AC1012 has no matching DXF output choice; dwg2dxf default selects AC1014

odaOutput.operation: reopen the same source as ACAD14 and ACAD2013 ASCII DXF
odaOutput.r14Header: AC1014 (read from physical HEADER, because ezdxf normalizes legacy DXF to AC1015 in memory)
odaOutput.observation: The same source dictionaries and child handles reopen with ACAD_PROXY_OBJECT children in R14 and typed detail/section style children in R2013; selected dictionary entry spelling is uppercased in R14. The physical R14 CLASSES section still names the classes. A proxy object is not evidence that class fields and behavior round-trip unchanged.

r14ProxyReopen2013.operation: ODA converts the generated R14 ASCII DXF back to ACAD2013 ASCII DXF
r14ProxyReopen2013.comparison: ezdxf 1.4.5 TagCollector exports each selected typed style as AC1027 and compares all ordered code/value tags with the direct AC2013 export of the original source
r14ProxyReopen2013.limitation: The same producer family performed both conversions; equality covers only the selected default style objects and exported tags, not dictionary name spelling, other objects, native semantics, or lossless whole-file output.

nextSteps: Before admitting this source/target profile, bind proxy class records and payload, source/target handles and dictionary entries, and establish lossless semantics after a native save/reopen or independent decoder.
Preserve exact-version refusal, output destination, and existing complete-read and graph checks until the evidence and cross-version implementation exist.
limitations: Only one locally created ODA codepage profile and the two output revisions were examined.
The same converter created and reopened the source; ezdxf inspects its outputs but cannot establish proxy semantics. This does not establish native AutoCAD behavior or complete output.
